scope: A01 J-SIG/J-PWR large-radius routing study. Shared parameters, tolerances, tolerance rules and bow cases are taken unchanged from Stage32 (inherits); the generator rejects any relaxed threshold. Nothing here is measured.

classes.MAKER_DOC: value read in an obtained maker document (sources.json)
classes.EXISTING_DESIGN: value from a committed repository design record
classes.DESIGN_ASSUMPTION: value chosen for this study, with a stated basis
classes.UNCONFIRMED: no basis; the value stays null

route_radius_mm.derivation: largest required radius over both links for any wire inside the JST OD window under a 10x OD maker rule, measured to the inner surface of the dressed bundle envelope: 10 x 1.0 + (1.5 x 1.0 + 0.25) = 11.75 mm (J-SIG); rounded up to the next 0.5 mm = 12.0 mm. Not an acceptance threshold: the criterion is route radius >= required radius per wire

bundle_dressing_allowance_mm.note: radial allowance for loose packing, lacing or a thin wrap; it enlarges the bundle envelope and moves the innermost conductor inward

flex_rule_sensitivity_x_od.note: sensitivity only: no candidate maker states a radius for repeated flexing; Alpha Wire states one bend radius without saying whether it is static or dynamic

service_flex_rule_x_od.note: no candidate document distinguishes installation from repeated service flexing

carrier_bottom_z_mm.note: middle carrier z 34-46; below it the neighbouring volume is undesigned (Stage32 U-FRONT)

gh_contact_current_limit_A.note: Stage10 power-return contract limit per GH contact

jst_current_rating_awg28_A.note: JST states the current rating at AWG #26 only; it is not transferred to AWG #28

jst_wire_plating.value: tin-plated stranded wire as a rule; other wires only after a compatibility check

jst_strand_count_min.note: no minimum strand count is stated in the obtained documents

j_pwr_conductor_current_max_A.note: largest conditional value over the Stage8 cases; mixed IQ maxima and nominal output currents, not a guaranteed total; faults and transients unknown

j_pwr_agnd_return_bound_A.derivation: sum of the three conditional rail maxima (every return through the single J-PWR AGND contact); a bound on the conditional values only

j_sig_conductor_current_A.note: J-SIG carries references and buffered signals; no per-conductor current is budgeted in the repository

rear_face_smt_process.note: a rear-face GH header adds an SMT side to A01-middle; process, cost and fixture are not evaluated

bend_radius_convention.value: the maker 'N x cable diameter' radius is taken to the inner surface of the bent body: a bundle bend needs centreline R >= N x OD + bundle envelope radius; a single-conductor S-bend needs centreline rho >= N x OD + OD/2. The innermost-conductor-centreline reading (R >= N x OD + envelope radius - OD/2) is reported for comparison only
bend_radius_convention.note: the Alpha Wire documents do not define the reference surface; the stricter reading is used

fan_in_offset_rule.value: outermost pin-row conductor ((n-1)/2 x pitch from the row centre) moves to the bundle ring in the row plane: hexagonal 7-bundle ring radius = OD, square 4-bundle ring radius = OD/sqrt(2); this is the smallest possible offset
fan_in_offset_rule.note: the real conductor mapping is not known; a larger offset needs a longer fan-in

lateral_retention.note: no retention part holds the R33 arches laterally; their lateral position in each enclosure orientation is not known (M33-04)

F33.title: Middle headers kept on the A01-middle front face; every bend at the route radius

paths: across a jack carrier crossmember (z 22-30) through the z 30-34 slot under the middle carrier, or below the jack carrier

around the +y edge of the jack board (y > 185, x < 232), descending through the undesigned front volume where the locked foreign hardware XY columns (unknown depth) sit, with the middle headers moved to y > 185
passage.note: the local exits sit on the jack board (x 195-240, y 94-182, z 35-36.6) and the middle board covers x >= 232 above z 48.4; the 2 mm gap x 240-242 is narrower than any bundle

R33.title: Middle headers moved to the A01-middle rear face; one vertical-plane arch per cable at R 12 with a straight fan-in at every housing exit
R33.route_shape: ARCH: straight up from the local exit for at least the fan-in length, one straight horizontal leg, straight down into the middle exit after at least the fan-in length; two 90-degree bends at the route radius

R33 assembly: Fit A01-middle on the middle carrier as in Stage10 (front carrier, spacers, M1-M4).
Fit the rear carrier and the core as in Stage10.
From the rear (rear cover off): mate J-SIG and J-PWR at the A01-jack local headers (+z), then at the A01-middle rear-face headers (-z), each housing pushed along its axis.
Dress each cable into one vertical-plane arch with the fan-in straight above each housing; no part holds the arch laterally (open condition, M33-04).
Refit the rear cover; the installed arch envelope tops (z 94.1 / 90.4) stay below its inner face (z 105) with the uniform bow added.
Core service (unchanged order): Power off; remove the rear cover.
Disconnect K-PWR, release the four core screws, hold both handles and withdraw the core 40 mm along +z. J-SIG/J-PWR are not touched; the J-PWR arch is 2.8 mm from the core volume in its ideal plane.
Do not move the core while a J-SIG/J-PWR housing is withdrawn: the raised arch reaches z 109.1 with both ends of J-SIG withdrawn and is not modelled against the core for that case.
Middle connector service: Power off; remove the rear cover. The core may stay installed.
Press the GH latch with a finger or a flat tool from the rear (latch face UNCONFIRMED: both long faces are open toward +z).

Hold the vertical bundle above the housing (about 23.1 mm straight installed, 15.6 mm at 15 mm withdrawal, both above the 10.4 mm fan-in) and pull within 15 degrees of +z (S-JST-HANDLING p.961). The arch rises; the cable keeps its design length.
Re-mate by pushing the housing along -z until the latch engages.
Harness replacement: Power off; remove the rear cover.
Unmate both middle ends, then both local ends, all from the rear. No board, carrier or the core is removed.
Front jack board removal: Unmate J-SIG and J-PWR at the middle ends from the rear, lift each free end back over the A01-middle edge to x < 232, then remove the front panel assembly as in Stage10 with the cables attached to A01-jack.
